statement: A SHA pin's version comment drifts silently when the floating tag it names moves, and an offline workflow linter cannot see it. 2026-11-17: cejel's zizmor gate runs --offline and was clean, yet one run of zizmor's online audits found 12 pins whose comments were stale. pnpm/action-setup@0ebf4713 said `# v6` but is v6.0.9, and actions/attest@f7c74d28 said `# v4` but is v4.2.0; both major tags had since moved to other commits. The pinned code was right, but the comments misled anyone auditing which release was trusted. Fix: write the exact version in a pin comment (`# v6.0.9`, not `# v6`), and run the online audits on a schedule (cejel's workflow-lint-online.yml). An offline gate cannot catch drift that happens upstream with no change in the repository.
